You’ll need to stay calm under pressure, ask the right questions and drive teams towards resolution while minimising business disruption. Your responsibilities will include: Leading major incident response, coordinating technical teams and driving timely resolution. Managing stakeholder communications, including updates to senior business and technology leaders. Facilitating post-incident reviews, root cause analysis and follow-up actions. Driving problem management to address recurring issues, document known errors and implement preventative measures. Overseeing change governance, risk assessments, Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings and post-implementation reviews. Monitoring service performance, SLAs and incident trends to identify opportunities for improvement. Continuously improving ITSM processes, documentation, reporting and operational practices. Supporting technology readiness and response activities for business emergency management exercises. Building strong relationships across technology, cyber, infrastructure, business teams and third-party providers. This is a hands-on, highly visible role suited to someone who enjoys taking ownership, working through complex technical issues and making things better rather than simply following a process. What You Bring To The Role You’re someone who takes initiative, thrives under pressure and naturally steps up when things get complicated. You’re curious about how things work, want to understand the root cause of problems and have the confidence to bring people together to get results. Experience facilitating post-incident reviews, root cause analysis and driving corrective and preventative actions. An understanding of change governance, risk management and continuous service improvement. Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Splunk. The ability to engage confidently with technical teams, including infrastructure, networking and cyber. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with excellent written and verbal English. A proactive, adaptable and outcomes-focused approach, with the confidence to challenge, influence and drive accountability. Above all, we’re looking for someone who takes ownership, runs towards a problem rather than away from it, and is motivated to improve the way things operate. The role is Melbourne based and must-have Australian working rights in hand. No sponsorship or visa support provided. Next Steps If you’re an experienced Major Incident Manager with experience in problem and/or change management and looking for a role where you can make a genuine difference, we’d love to hear from you.
